title: EDK-NightVision
description: When Player type /nv they get nightvision
body:
Features
- Adds `/nv` to toggle unlimited night vision on and off
- Adds `/nv help`
- Adds `/nv reload`
- Supports Paper and Purpur 1.21 to 1.21.11
- Uses permissions for all commands
- Operators can use commands by default
- Compatible with LuckPerms permission assignment
- Includes configurable `messages.yml` with editable prefix and messages
- 
 Permissions
- `edknightvision.use`
- `edknightvision.help`
- `edknightvision.reload`
